name: parallel-todo-demo
description: Todo App demonstrating parallel agent workflow (backend + frontend + shared types)

scripts.install:all: cd backend && npm install && cd ../frontend && npm install && cd ../shared && npm install
scripts.build: cd backend && npm run build && cd ../frontend && npm run build
scripts.typecheck: cd backend && npm run typecheck && cd ../frontend && npm run typecheck && cd ../shared && npm run typecheck
